description: Retrieve a Shopify-owned cart with its cart_access_token from create_cart. Retain the full cart id, owner token, and continue_url. The agent_checkout field describes how the buyer's separate Shop MCP connection can convert this cart and complete an approved purchase; it does not itself place an order.

cart_access_token.description: Owner credential returned by create_cart for this cart id.

name: get_cart
title: Get Shopify cart
